definition: Unique row ID generated by this project.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Current A. oryzae RIB40 locus tag selected by the ID-mapping step.
allowed_values: free text (AO090 plus nine digits) or blank
blank_means: No single current locus was independently verified.

definition: Locus tag exactly as printed by Liu et al. 2014.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: The four Liu Table S1 SOURCE cells in order, joined with pipes without changing cell text.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Table S1 physical workbook row.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Current accepted A. oryzae gene symbol where available.
blank_means: No accepted short gene symbol was found; use ao_locus_tag instead.

definition: Plain-English function selected from the Liu description or current annotation.
blank_means: Neither Liu nor the current annotation supplied a usable description.

definition: Row type retained so machinery genes cannot be silently mixed with other biological lists.
value_meanings: machinery_component = one gene from Liu's secretion-machinery list
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Primary secretion-pathway stage used for table grouping and diagram placement.
allowed_values: tc | dolichol_pathway | er_glycosylation | folding | gpi_biosynthesis | erad | copii | copi | golgi_processing | ldsv | hdsv | cpy_pathway | alp_pathway | snare | septin | beta_1_6_glucan_biosynthesis | translation | putative_mitochondria_protein | mitochondrial_m_aaa_protease | blank
value_meanings: tc = entry into the secretion pathway; dolichol_pathway and er_glycosylation = N-glycan assembly/transfer; folding = protein folding; gpi_biosynthesis = GPI-anchor production; erad = ER quality-control degradation; copii = ER-to-Golgi transport; copi = Golgi-to-ER transport; golgi_processing = Golgi glycan processing; ldsv/hdsv = low/high-density secretory vesicles; cpy_pathway/alp_pathway = vacuolar sorting routes; snare = vesicle fusion; remaining values name specialized processes
blank_means: Not enough evidence to choose one primary pathway stage; the gene remains in the atlas.

definition: Main evidence route used to assign subsystem; see subsystem_rationale for the gene-specific explanation.
allowed_values: liu2014 | liu2014_description | yeast_scaffold | current_annotation | kegg_pathway | curated_liu_composite | aspergillus_homolog | unassigned
value_meanings: liu2014 = Liu supplied the stage directly; liu2014_description = inferred from Liu's description; yeast_scaffold = inferred through the yeast counterpart; current_annotation = inferred from a current database description; kegg_pathway = inferred from broad KEGG pathway membership; curated_liu_composite = manually reviewed agreement among several Liu clues; aspergillus_homolog = inferred from a related Aspergillus gene; unassigned = no route was strong enough
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Strength of support for the primary subsystem assignment, not confidence in the gene's general function or ID mapping.
value_meanings: high = stated directly by Liu or manually reviewed agreement among multiple specific sources; medium = one specific indirect source such as Liu's description, a unique yeast match, or a current annotation; low = only broad KEGG evidence or no defensible assignment
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Short explanation for the primary subsystem assignment.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Reviewed additional pathway role retained on the same one-gene row.
blank_means: No separate secondary role was reviewed and retained; this does not prove the gene has only one function.

definition: Short explanation for the reviewed secondary pathway role.
blank_means: No secondary_subsystem was assigned.

definition: Number used only to place subsystem boxes in the pathway diagram.
value_meanings: Smaller numbers appear earlier in the diagram; the number is not a confidence score, rank, or biological priority.
blank_means: No primary subsystem was assigned, so there is no diagram position.

definition: Controlled label for the gene product's main cellular location.
allowed_values: cytosol | ER | Golgi | vesicle | membrane | vacuole | extracellular | unknown
value_meanings: unknown = available evidence did not support one location; other values name the assigned location
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Evidence route used for the compartment label.
value_meanings: uniprot = one clear UniProt location; uniprot_conflict = UniProt listed conflicting or multiple locations, so compartment is unknown; subsystem_inference = inferred from the assigned pathway stage; unassigned = no usable location evidence
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Strength of support for the compartment label only.
value_meanings: high = one clear UniProt location; medium = inferred from a pathway stage; low = conflicting or absent location evidence
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Specific sugar-modification process assigned to the gene.
allowed_values: n_glycan_assembly | n_glycan_transfer | n_glycan_trimming | golgi_mannosylation | o_glycosylation | gpi_anchor | none
value_meanings: n_glycan_assembly = build the precursor N-glycan; n_glycan_transfer = attach it to a protein; n_glycan_trimming = remove sugars during processing/quality control; golgi_mannosylation = add mannose in the Golgi; o_glycosylation = attach sugars through oxygen; gpi_anchor = build a GPI membrane anchor; none = no role assigned by this atlas
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Evidence route used for glycosylation_role.
allowed_values: liu2014 | liu2014_description | yeast_scaffold | current_annotation | kegg_pathway | kegg_ko | liu_description_or_current_annotation | curated_multi_source_evidence | blank
value_meanings: liu2014 = direct Liu pathway label; liu2014_description = Liu description; yeast_scaffold = matching yeast gene; current_annotation = current database description; kegg_pathway = broad KEGG pathway; kegg_ko = KEGG functional group; liu_description_or_current_annotation = one specific matching description; curated_multi_source_evidence = manually reviewed agreement among multiple sources
blank_means: Blank because glycosylation_role is none; no source is claimed for an unassigned role.

definition: Strength of support for glycosylation_role only, not general function confidence.
value_meanings: high = direct Liu assignment or manually reviewed agreement among several specific sources; medium = one specific indirect route such as a description, yeast match, KEGG pathway, or KEGG functional group; low = reserved for weak assignments (none are present in this release)
blank_means: Blank because glycosylation_role is none; an unassigned role receives no confidence score.

definition: Whether all three Liu adjusted p-values are below 0.05.
value_meanings: true = statistically significant in all three high-secretion strains; false = at least one comparison was not significant
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Shared expression direction when the gene is significant in all three comparisons.
value_meanings: up = expression increased in all three strains; down = expression decreased in all three strains
blank_means: The gene was not significant in all three comparisons, or the three directions did not agree.

definition: Publication or process that placed the gene row in the atlas.
value_meanings: liu2014 = gene was in Liu's 369-gene list; post_2014_literature and new_orthology_inference are reserved for possible future expansion
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Broad type of evidence Liu used to include or support the gene; this is not the subsystem confidence score.
allowed_values: a_oryzae_experimental | a_oryzae_transcriptomic | aspergillus_homolog | yeast_inference | database_prediction | unknown
value_meanings: a_oryzae_experimental = direct experiment in A. oryzae; a_oryzae_transcriptomic = A. oryzae expression evidence; aspergillus_homolog = evidence from a related Aspergillus species; yeast_inference = inferred through a yeast counterpart; database_prediction = computational database prediction; unknown = source text could not be classified
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: S. cerevisiae counterpart exactly as recorded by Liu.
blank_means: Liu did not provide a yeast counterpart for this gene.

definition: Liu 2014 DOI supporting every machinery record.
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Result of checking the 2014 gene ID against current database records.
allowed_values: exact | cross_reference | sequence | orthology | ambiguous | split | merged | unresolved
value_meanings: exact = the same AO090 ID is current; cross_reference = linked by an authoritative database cross-reference; sequence = linked by sequence identity; orthology = only an evolutionary counterpart supports the link, not exact identity; ambiguous = more than one current candidate; split = one old gene became several models; merged = several old genes became one model; unresolved = no current gene was verified
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Specific route used to reach mapping_status.
allowed_values: direct_locus_tag | cross_reference | sequence | orthology | ambiguous | split | merged | unresolved
value_meanings: direct_locus_tag = exact AO090 text match; cross_reference = authoritative database link; sequence = sequence identity; orthology = evolutionary relationship only; ambiguous/split/merged/unresolved mirror the unresolved mapping outcome
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Whether any automated mapping or annotation decision needs a person to inspect it.
value_meanings: true = at least one mapping or annotation issue needs review; false = no review trigger was raised, not that every biological claim is experimentally proven
blank_means: This field is not expected to be blank.

definition: Current UniProt protein-record identifier.
blank_means: No single UniProt record was found or selected; alternatives may remain in gene_id_mapping.csv.

definition: Current KEGG A. oryzae gene identifier.
blank_means: No KEGG gene link was supplied or selected for this row.

definition: KEGG Orthology functional-group identifier supplied by KEGG.
value_meanings: Genes sharing a KO are treated by KEGG as performing an equivalent broad function across species.
blank_means: KEGG did not supply a KO link; this is incomplete annotation, not evidence that the gene has no function.

definition: Current NCBI Gene numeric identifier.
blank_means: No unambiguous NCBI Gene link was available from the retrieved cross-references.
